translations./garage/brief: High torque and high efficiency have different personalities. Predict which arrives first and which saves energy, then let RO-1 demonstrate.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. Compare finish time with energy use; both matter.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: The high-torque motor must be fastest
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Probably—but inspect its energy bill too.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: The efficient motor is best overall
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: If it is fast enough and uses less energy, this route did not need the extra torque.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Learning the new motor’s personality.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Torque and efficiency share the same scorecard. There is no free lunch.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Try another motor or leave more room in the build budget.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Time and energy come from the simulation, not flavor text.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Trial failed: calibration pad not reached
